pins.name: EN
pins.notes: KEY/EN: HIGH at power-up enters AT command mode. Leave unconnected normally

pins.name: TXD
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (3.3 V level)

pins.name: RXD
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin
